about: In the bustling legal landscape of Addison, Illinois, at the Driver Defense Team, stands James P. McLane III, a legal virtuoso with over two decades of experience. More than just an attorney, he is a strategic architect in the realms of civil, criminal and personal injury law. With over 25 cases tried to verdict, his trial experience spans personal injury, criminal defense and appellate law.

Mr. McLane has defended clients in serious criminal cases, including attempted murder, sexual assault and mortgage fraud. His work with the California Innocence Project and impactful rulings on Illinois discovery rules underscore his commitment to justice. He isn't just known for his sharp analytical skills and innovative legal strategies; he's celebrated for his unwavering commitment to his clients. He has earned his stripes as a highly capable litigator, skillfully navigating both high-stakes criminal defense and intricate civil litigation.

But Mr. McLane's competence doesn't end in the courtroom. As a seasoned negotiator, he excels in mediation and arbitration, securing favorable settlements in diverse cases, from auto accidents to business disputes. At the Driver Defense Team, he channels his deep understanding of traffic and criminal law into crafting strategic defenses for clients facing DUI and other driving-related offenses.

A graduate of California Western School of Law (2003), Mr. McLane was admitted to practice in California (2004) and Illinois (2005). His credentials extend to the United States District Court for the Northern District of Illinois and the United States Court of Appeals for the 11th Circuit. His academic foundation includes degrees from California State University at Fullerton and the University of California Santa Barbara.

An active member of the Federal Trial Bar, Mr. McLane boasts an Avvo rating of 9.8 and accolades such as Top 100 Criminal Defense Lawyers in Illinois by the National Trial Lawyers, the Best DUI Lawyers in Schaumburg by Expertise and Top 40 Under 40 in Illinois by the American Society of Legal Advocates.
